contract_and_property.existing_contract: The shared persist_bundle_and_event API adds an optional strict bool return_selected_profile=False. The default preserves legacy profileless KnowledgeBundleRef behavior. When opted in, the exact ArtifactRef returned by the store is converted with model_dump(mode="json") and validated into KnowledgeBundleRef, retaining manifest_profile_sha256.
contract_and_property.fresh_graph_reopen: An independent wrapper opens all three produced graph refs with a new FileSystemCAS and loads each through load_causal_graph_model. contract_and_property.profileless_legacy_control: The default writer remains profileless and the graph/prior route retains a None input profile for the profileless legacy ref. This is a compatibility witness, not proof of profileless-history migration or reader-materialized authority.
contract_and_property.refresh_producer: The stale-refresh _finalize_refreshed_bundle caller invokes _store_bundle_payload, which asks ctx.store.put_json for return_selected_profile=True and returns the typed ref including the selected profile. The freshness module exercises the storage route; its refresh provider fixture is fake, so no external enrichment authority is claimed.
contract_and_property.same_bytes_sibling_control: The test writes the selected KB payload bytes under a sibling schema/profile. Both refs share the same artifact_id and differ in manifest_profile_sha256. Fresh CAS manifest reads preserve both exact profiles; prior and graph input edges preserve the distinct selection digests.
contract_and_property.semantic_effect: This proves bounded selected-view provenance in a real Scholar→KnowledgeBundle→prior/graph manifest lineage route and selected graph re-read. It establishes neither causal dependence on bundle content nor payload truth, law, authority, currentness, calibration, or publication eligibility.

pattern_review.P37: The selected manifest digest is independently recomputed from the CAS manifest and compared with the emitted ref and persisted input edges. A selector name or matching artifact_id is insufficient.
pattern_review.P38: Payload bytes and artifact_id alone collapse the selected and sibling-profile views. This exact same-byte/different-profile control demonstrates that divergence and the manifest lineage preserves the distinction.
pattern_review.anti_pattern_found: A selected artifact ref could lose its selected manifest profile while crossing a KnowledgeBundle producer/consumer boundary; a second same-byte view demonstrates that artifact ID/payload alone is not the selected view.
pattern_review.authority_limit: Profile selection is provenance metadata; it does not establish source truth or authority.
pattern_review.target_pattern: Reuse the existing ArtifactStore selected-profile return; preserve the exact returned typed ref through real producers and manifest input edges; retain profileless compatibility explicitly; verify via fresh manifest and consumer reads.
